name: Sync Seat Dev Environment
postCreateCommand:
mkdir -p ~/.kube && echo 'apiVersion: v1
clusters:
- cluster:
    insecure-skip-tls-verify: true
    server: https://127.0.0.1:6443
  name: kind-sync-seat
contexts:
- context:
    cluster: kind-sync-seat
    user: kind-sync-seat
  name: kind-sync-seat
current-context: kind-sync-seat
kind: Config
users:
- name: kind-sync-seat
  user:
    token: placeholder' > ~/.kube/config
